name: Rhys Llewellyn
bio:
Rhys Llewellyn's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with engines on his family's farm in rural Wales. This practical experience, combined with a passion for racing, led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he joined a small Formula 3 team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous approach and knack for problem-solving.

His career took a significant leap when he was recruited by Rahal Letterman Lanigan. Rhys is known for his ability to blend established engineering principles with innovative solutions, creating a harmonious balance between reliability and performance. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their expertise, making him a highly respected and effective technical director.

What sets Rhys apart is his unflappable demeanor under pressure. He can dissect complex technical challenges with a calm and collected mind, a trait that has proven invaluable during high-stakes race weekends. His deep understanding of vehicle dynamics, combined with his innate ability to communicate complex ideas simply, makes him a unique asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rhys has a thoughtful look about him, with kind eyes and a strong jawline.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out torque wrench, a souvenir from his early days.
Has a habit of sketching engineering diagrams on napkins during lunch.
Insists on a pre-race team huddle where everyone shares one thing they're grateful for.
